pack.title: Mogul Money
pack.description: A full show adapted from an episode of Ludwig's Mogul Money: ten board categories, a Baseball category for Final Trivia and the five Fast Money surveys. Questions are paraphrased. Dubbin and a few other clues are about the show and its host. Only the top survey answer comes from the episode; the other answers and all survey numbers are illustrative.
pack.author: Adapted from Mogul Money

categories.title: Names the Same
categories.blurb: Two people, one first name. Tell us the name they share.

clues.question: What first name is shared by the streamers Kjellberg, known as PewDiePie, and Lengyel, known as xQc?
What first name does the "Twilight" actor Lautner share with his wife, who is also a Lautner?
clues.notes: Taylor Lautner married Taylor Dome in 2022 and she took his surname.

clues.question: What first name connects the actors Rogen and Green?
What first name connects the comedian Poehler and the singer Winehouse?
What first name connects the comedian Lopez and the singer Michael?

categories.title: Exploring Bodies
categories.blurb: Human anatomy, from the bones outwards.

clues.question: Which bone is the longest and largest in the human body?
What is the largest organ of the human body?
Which organ stores bile and releases it to help with digestion?
clues.notes: The liver makes bile; the gallbladder only stores and releases it.

clues.question: Which part of the brain handles higher-level processes such as reasoning, memory and sensory information?
clues.notes: "Cerebrum" is close but is the larger structure; the cortex is its outer layer. Host's call.

clues.question: Which body system controls the production and regulation of hormones?

categories.title: Tip2Tip
categories.blurb: Estimate a distance in miles. Each clue says how close you need to be.

clues.question: To the nearest 500 miles, how wide is the United States from east to west?
clues.notes: The show's figure is 2,800 miles, which rounds to 3,000. Give 2,500 at your discretion.

clues.question: To the nearest 500 miles, how far does China extend from north to south?
clues.notes: The show's figure is 3,400 miles, which rounds to 3,500.

clues.question: To the nearest 10 miles, how wide is Chile at its narrowest point from east to west?
clues.notes: This is the show's figure. Other sources measure the narrowest point differently and give a larger number, so judge generously.

clues.question: To the nearest 500 miles, how far does Russia extend from east to west?
clues.notes: The show's figure is 5,600 miles, which rounds to 5,500. Give 6,000 at your discretion.

clues.question: To the nearest 1,000 miles, what is the distance over the Earth's surface from the North Pole to the South Pole?
clues.notes: Half of the Earth's circumference through the poles.

categories.title: Few-Wheeled Vehicles
categories.blurb: Things you ride or drive on three wheels or fewer.

clues.question: Which single-wheeled vehicle is associated with circus performers and acrobats?
Which famous Italian scooter brand made its debut in 1946?
clues.notes: Made by Piaggio. "Vespa" is Italian for wasp.

clues.question: Which three-wheeled motorised taxi is a common sight in Southeast Asia?
Which self-balancing, two-wheeled personal transporter was invented by Dean Kamen?
Which three-wheeled vehicle went on sale in 2014 with a starting price of about $19,999?

categories.title: League of Legends
categories.blurb: Champions, monsters and items from Summoner's Rift.

clues.question: Which champion, a star of the series "Arcane", is known for her long blue twin braids?
clues.notes: Powder is her name as a child in Arcane.

clues.question: Which scarecrow champion, sometimes played as a support, shares a name with Ludwig's alter ego "the Fiddler"?
clues.notes: Show-specific: the Fiddler is a running bit of Ludwig's.

clues.question: On which map are standard games of League of Legends played?
What is the proper name of the jungle monster that players usually just call "Red Buff"?
Which item builds up stacks over time and, once fully stacked, grants its owner a level?

categories.title: Not an Alloy
categories.blurb: Every answer is a metal, and a pure one.

clues.question: Which abundant metal is commonly found in kitchen utensils and kitchen foil?
clues.notes: The show also accepted iron after a dispute over whether "abundant" meant in the Earth's crust or in the whole planet.

clues.question: Which shiny precious metal is traditionally used for fine tableware?
Which metal is a liquid at ordinary room temperature?
Which metal in a cheap gold-coloured ring can turn the skin underneath it green?
Which highly corrosion-resistant metal of the platinum group has been called the most valuable precious metal?
clues.notes: Its price moves a lot, so "most valuable" is as the show described it rather than a fixed fact.

categories.title: Dubbin
categories.blurb: Show-specific: trivia about Mogul Money's host, Ludwig.

clues.question: Which two contestants on this episode of Mogul Money are Ludwig's prospective groomsmen?
clues.notes: Only makes sense to people who know the episode's line-up.

clues.question: What is the medical name for Ludwig's sunken-chest condition?
Which Smash Bros. video was the first of Ludwig's uploads to reach one million views?
Which multiplayer game on the PSP frustrated Ludwig so much that he damaged his control stick?
clues.notes: "Star Wars Battlefront" alone is the host's call.

clues.question: At which charity Smash tournament did Ludwig beat ChillinDude's Mario?

categories.title: Real Creamers
categories.blurb: Milk, cream and the things made from them.

clues.question: What do you get by churning heavy cream?
What is Ludwig's favourite flavour of ice cream?
clues.notes: Show-specific. The show also accepted Double Dough.

clues.question: Which sugar found in milk is digested with the help of the enzyme lactase?
Which heat treatment makes raw milk safer to drink by reducing harmful microorganisms?
clues.notes: Named after Louis Pasteur.

clues.question: Which month is recognised as National Dairy Month in the United States?

categories.title: Hypothetically Speaking
categories.blurb: Every answer is a theory or a theorem.

clues.question: Which theorem relates the sides of a right-angled triangle with the formula a² + b² = c²?
Which scientific theory, associated with Charles Darwin, explains how species change over generations?
Which cosmological theory describes the universe expanding from an early hot, dense state?
Which theory developed by Albert Einstein changed our understanding of space, time and gravity?
clues.notes: "Special relativity" alone leaves out gravity. Host's call.

clues.question: Which field of mathematics studies strategic decisions made by rational participants?

categories.title: Boggle
categories.blurb: Find the word. Answers grow by two letters a clue: 2, 4, 6, 8, then 10.

clues.question: Give a two-letter word meaning to move or travel.
Give a four-letter word for something uninteresting or lacking excitement.
clues.notes: The show's answer is DULL. Other four-letter words that fit are the host's call.

clues.question: Which six-letter word means a financial plan of expected income and spending?
Which eight-letter word means exaggerated or assertive masculine pride?
Which ten-letter word names a decorative light fitting that hangs from the ceiling?

categories.title: Baseball
categories.blurb: The show's Final Trivia category. Pick it for Final Trivia and the last clue is asked.

clues.question: How many strikes does it take to strike a batter out?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: How many players does a baseball team have on the field when it is defending?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: What is a home run called when it is hit with the bases loaded?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: Which New York Yankees slugger was nicknamed "the Sultan of Swat"?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: Which team did the Los Angeles Dodgers beat in Game 7 of the 2025 World Series?
clues.notes: The show's Final Trivia question.

surveys.question: Name a flavour of ice cream.
What percentage would you tip for good service?
How many times a day do you use the bathroom?
Name something a person might get caught in.
Name something a doctor might remove from somebody.
